- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Green roofs and buildings reduce waste by using materials like recycled rubber, plastic, and wood, promoting eco-friendliness.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, green roofs and buildings are crucial for sustainability efforts in urban areas, providing environmental, social, and economic benefits.
